sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 回想起来，当年在黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ时，每晚你都要带着300件最珍爱的宝贝去上班，把DJ台变成

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 一个类似于活生生的流行快闪博物馆，摆满了美丽的50年历史的老物件。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times and the team that brought you The Daily,
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》和打造《每日》的团队，

sentences.en: this is Caliphate.
sentences.zh: 这是《哈里发国》。

sentences.en: Take me to the first execution.
sentences.zh: 带我回到第一次行刑的现场。

sentences.en: This was in June.
sentences.zh: 那是在六月。

sentences.en: At that time, they were celebrating a lot of all the victories we've had in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 当时，他们在庆祝我们在伊拉克取得的许多胜利。

sentences.en: And we were reaching towards Mosul pretty faSt.
sentences.zh: 而且我们正以极快的速度逼近摩苏尔。

sentences.en: After that, Ramadi, then straight to Baghdad.
sentences.zh: 在那之后是拉马迪，然后直奔巴格达。

sentences.en: But what happened was Abu Nimr tribe was a local tribe that stood against, they said they stood against Islam, they stood against the state.
sentences.zh: 但发生的情况是，阿布·尼姆尔部落是一个当地部落，他们起而对抗，他们说他们对抗伊斯兰教，对抗国家。

sentences.en: So they killed the majority of them in Iraq, and they brought back the important ones back into Syria.
sentences.zh: 于是他们在伊拉克杀害了其中大部分人，并将重要人物带回了叙利亚。

sentences.en: And we were the ones who had to carry out their execution.
sentences.zh: 而我们就是不得不执行他们死刑的人。

sentences.en: They said, they told us that their apostates from Iraq,
sentences.zh: 他们说，他们告诉我们这些人是来自伊拉克的叛教者，

sentences.en: Murt al-Din, to me, Murt al-Din was, like, the worst thing in the world.
sentences.zh: 对我和穆尔塔丁来说，穆尔塔丁简直是世界上最糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: That's a guy who just turned away from Islam.
sentences.zh: 那就是一个背叛了伊斯兰教的人。

sentences.en: And they were being brought in to face punishment.
sentences.zh: 而他们被带回来接受惩罚。

sentences.en: They were being brought in for justice.
sentences.zh: 他们被带回来接受正义的审判。

sentences.en: And you thought that he really was?
sentences.zh: 而你真的认为他是吗？

sentences.en: I mean, so the word Murtad means an apostate, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，Murtad这个词的意思是叛教者，对吧？

sentences.en: But the members of this tribe, they were Sunni Muslims, right?
sentences.zh: 但这个部落的成员，他们是逊尼派穆斯林，对吧？

sentences.en: They were Sunni Muslims, yes.
sentences.zh: 他们是逊尼派穆斯林，是的。

sentences.en: So their only crime was that they had contradicted ISIS.
sentences.zh: 所以他们唯一的罪过就是他们顶撞了ISIS。

sentences.en: They stood up, they stopped us from getting to Baghdad.
sentences.zh: 他们站出来，阻止我们进入巴格达。

sentences.en: Okay, they stood in your way.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们挡了你们的路。

sentences.en: They stood in our way.
sentences.zh: 他们挡了我们的路。

sentences.en: They wouldn't let us take over their city, their village.
sentences.zh: 他们不让我们接管他们的城市、他们的村庄。

sentences.en: They wouldn't let us go any further.
sentences.zh: 他们不让我们再前进一步。

sentences.en: They stopped us.
sentences.zh: 他们阻止了我们。

sentences.en: They put up resistance that we didn't have to face.
sentences.zh: 他们发起了我们本不必面对的抵抗。

sentences.en: That's what one of the guys described it as.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人是这样描述的。

sentences.en: They stood up against us when they didn't have to.
sentences.zh: 本不必如此，他们却偏要与我们作对。

sentences.en: They could have always conformed to us and lived comfortably or, you know, lived normally.
sentences.zh: 他们本可以一直顺从我们，舒舒服服地生活，或者，你知道的，过上正常的生活。

sentences.en: We didn't have to go through it.
sentences.zh: 我们本不必经历这些。

sentences.en: But they put themselves in that situation.
sentences.zh: 但他们把自己置于那种境地。

sentences.en: They killed themselves.
sentences.zh: 是他们自寻死路。

sentences.en: That's what they said.
sentences.zh: 他们是这么说的。

sentences.en: And you believe that?
sentences.zh: 而你相信吗？

sentences.en: I believe that, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我相信，是的。

sentences.en: Chapter four, us versus them.
sentences.zh: 第四章，我们与他们。

sentences.en: Okay, so he's saying that it's June now.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以他说现在是六月。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Where is ISIS at this moment?
sentences.zh: 此时ISIS在哪里？

sentences.en: In June of 2014, we are moments before the declaration of the caliphate, and we are right now on the cusp of ISIS becoming the group that we know it to be, to be on every page
sentences.zh: 在2014年6月，我们正处于宣布建立哈里发国的前夕，而我们现在正处于ISIS即将成为我们所熟知的那个集团的边缘，它将出现在每一个

sentences.en: one, above the fold, on every newscaSt.
sentences.zh: 头版、头条、每一条新闻广播中。

sentences.en: And as I'm sitting there across from Josefa in the hotel room, there are two things that jump out at me when he says this.
sentences.zh: 当我坐在酒店房间里面对着胡泽法时，当他说出这句话时，有两件事引起了我的注意。

sentences.en: Number one is the us versus them and the heights that ISIS takes it to.
sentences.zh: 第一点是我们与他们的对立，以及ISIS将这种对立推到了何等极端的程度。

sentences.en: The Abu Nimr tribe is a Sunni tribe.
sentences.zh: 阿布·尼姆尔部落是一个逊尼派部落。

sentences.en: This is the same sect as ISIS.
sentences.zh: 这与ISIS属于同一教派。

sentences.en: These are the very people that ISIS calls Muslims and considers the citizens of their caliphate.
sentences.zh: 这些人正是ISIS口中的穆斯林，并被视为他们哈里发国的公民。

sentences.en: But they have now been described as apostates, as murtadin.
sentences.zh: 但他们现在却被描述为叛教者，即murtadin。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because they stood up to ISIS.
sentences.zh: 因为他们敢于对抗ISIS。

sentences.en: The very act of disagreeing with the Islamic State is essentially equivalent to disagreeing with God.
sentences.zh: 不同意伊斯兰国的这种行为，本质上等同于与上帝作对。

sentences.en: And the second thing is he properly identifies the crime that ISIS assigns to this group.
sentences.zh: 第二点是，他准确地指出了ISIS强加给这个群体的罪名。

sentences.en: And he's using the correct theological terms to refer to them.
sentences.zh: 而且他使用了正确的神学术语来指代他们。

sentences.en: And that's something that is pretty in the weeds, right?
sentences.zh: 这可是一个相当冷门的专业领域，对吧？

sentences.en: Really specific.
sentences.zh: 非常具体。

sentences.en: In addition to that, he says that leaders of the tribe were also kidnapped and taken back to Syria.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，他还说该部落的领导人也被绑架并带回了叙利亚。

sentences.en: And this is something that suggests insider knowledge.
sentences.zh: 这表明他掌握了内部消息。

sentences.en: How does ISIS prepare you to kill people?
sentences.zh: ISIS是如何训练你们杀人的？

sentences.en: Is there anything?
sentences.zh: 有什么特殊的吗？

sentences.en: We had dolls.
sentences.zh: 我们有玩偶。

sentences.en: Yeah, we had dolls to practice on.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们有用来练习的玩偶。

sentences.en: We also have cutouts of ballistics gels.
sentences.zh: 我们还有弹道凝胶做成的模型切片。

sentences.en: It would feel a lot like human.
sentences.zh: 感觉非常像真人。

sentences.en: And inside the ballistics gels, they'd have sacks where major organs would be.
sentences.zh: 在弹道凝胶内部，它们有模拟主要器官的囊袋。

sentences.en: And then you could just slice, practice, behead, stab, and, you know, just practice.
sentences.zh: 然后你就可以劈砍、练习、斩首、刺杀，你知道的，就是尽情练习。

sentences.en: And then we'd also fire weapons into them to see what damage a bullet would do.
sentences.zh: 然后我们还会向它们开枪，看看子弹会造成什么样的破坏。

sentences.en: So it kind of felt like what a medical student would do.
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像医学生会做的事情。

sentences.en: This is something you learned in the training.
sentences.zh: 这是你在训练中学的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You had to know how to slice a head off.
sentences.zh: 你必须知道如何割下一个人的头。

sentences.en: When it comes to the act of violence itself, how is it, like, going into this, what is
sentences.zh: 说到暴力行为本身，情况是怎样的，在进入这一步时，

sentences.en: it that you know about how ISIS gets somebody like Huzefa, who's kind of this awkward kid, and turns them into someone who can actually take a human life?
sentences.zh: 你对ISIS如何将胡泽法这样有点笨拙的孩子，变成一个能够真正夺走他人生命的人，了解多少？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what I know from reading the interrogation records of numerous ISIS suspects who were who were arrested on their way home, and from interviewing ISIS members myself, ISIS seems
sentences.zh: 所以，根据我阅读的大量在回家路上被捕的ISIS嫌疑人的审讯记录，以及我自己对ISIS成员的采访，ISIS似乎

sentences.en: to have a series of steps that they take people through to essentially desensitize them to violence.
sentences.zh: 有一系列步骤，引导人们一步步对暴力习以为常，从而逐渐麻木。

sentences.en: So first of all, they practice on non-human entities.
sentences.zh: 所以首先，他们在非人类实体上进行练习。

sentences.en: They use dolls.
sentences.zh: 他们使用玩偶。

sentences.en: They use mannequins.
sentences.zh: 他们使用人体模型。

sentences.en: They make them very lifelike.
sentences.zh: 他们把它们做得非常逼真。

sentences.en: And then they put them on kitchen duty.
sentences.zh: 然后他们让他们值厨房勤务。

sentences.en: The ISIS fighters are told to go and slaughter the chicken or slit the throat of the lamb that they're going to have for dinner.
sentences.zh: ISIS的战士被告知要去宰杀鸡，或者割断他们晚餐要吃的羔羊的喉咙。

sentences.en: The next step is a communal killing.
sentences.zh: 下一步是集体屠杀。

sentences.en: In the group execution, there's some level of anonymity because you're one of several people who are doing this.
sentences.zh: 在集体行刑中，存在某种程度的匿名性，因为你是执行此事的数人之一。

sentences.en: And there's a camaraderie, I hate to say it, but there's a support system in the sense that you're all doing it together.
sentences.zh: 而且有一种同志情谊，虽然我不想这么说，但确实存在一种支持系统，因为你们都在一起做这件事。

sentences.en: You're all doing it on cue.
sentences.zh: 你们都在听从指令行事。

sentences.en: There's something mechanical and automatic and communal, you know, about it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这其中有一种机械化、自动化和集体的感觉。

sentences.en: So describe to me what happened that day.
sentences.zh: 那么，请向我描述一下那天发生了什么。

sentences.en: So we have regular routine, wake up, pray, breakfast, and they bought us out just before afternoon.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有常规的作息，起床、祈祷、吃早餐，他们在下午之前把我们带了出来。

sentences.en: He then says that this was done in the center of the city.
sentences.zh: 他接着说，这是在市中心进行的。

sentences.en: They all went out to a public place.
sentences.zh: 他们都去了公共场所。

sentences.en: They gathered people for this, and they told us that we're going to stand in this certain formation.
sentences.zh: 他们为此把人们聚集起来，告诉我们必须按照某种特定的队形站立。

sentences.en: And according to his telling, and the guys are going to be in front of us, one shot clean to the head, just finish them off.
sentences.zh: 根据他的讲述，那些人将站在我们面前，一枪正中头部，彻底结果他们。

sentences.en: What he was about to do was something he was going to do with the people he considered his brothers.
sentences.zh: 他即将要做的事情，是与他视为兄弟的人一起完成的。

sentences.en: These are the people that he trained with, that he had every meal with, every one of the five daily prayers, the people that he slept in the same dorms with.
sentences.zh: 这些人是他一起训练的，和他一起吃每一顿饭的，一起做每日五次礼拜的，和他睡在同一个宿舍里的人。

sentences.en: And now they are taking a human life, and they're going to do this together.
sentences.zh: 而现在他们正在剥夺一条生命，并且他们将一起完成这件事。

sentences.en: And then what happened is a few hours, a couple of hours later, a few hours later, they bought in these old men.
sentences.zh: 然后发生的事情是，几个小时后，又过了几个小时，他们把这些老人带了进来。

sentences.en: They had blue uniforms on.
sentences.zh: 他们穿着蓝色制服。

sentences.en: They were like jumpsuits, full uniform, blue color, navy blue, you could say.
sentences.zh: 就像连体工作服，全套制服，可以说，是海军蓝的颜色。

sentences.en: They were blindfolded and hand cut, roped behind their hands.
sentences.zh: 他们被蒙住双眼，双手被反绑在身后。

sentences.en: And they just came in in a line, sat in front of us.
sentences.zh: 他们排成一列走进来，坐在我们面前。

sentences.en: And they bring them out in a single file and make each prisoner kneel in front of each executioner.
sentences.zh: 他们把他们单列纵队带出来，让每个囚犯跪在每个行刑者面前。

sentences.en: No emotions on them.
sentences.zh: 他们脸上没有任何表情。

sentences.en: They looked like animals to me at that point.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，在我看来他们就像动物一样。

sentences.en: He was facing you?
sentences.zh: 他当时面对着你吗？

sentences.en: No, he was facing the other way.
sentences.zh: 不，他面对着另一个方向。

sentences.en: But when he came in, he was normal.
sentences.zh: 但当他进来时，他很平静。

sentences.en: Like he accepted his fate kind of type thing.
sentences.zh: 有点像那种接受了自己命运的样子。

sentences.en: And then they're supposed to wait.
sentences.zh: 然后他们必须等待。

sentences.en: The guy in a distance in front of us would give us a cue.
sentences.zh: 远处在我们面前的一个人会给我们一个暗号。

sentences.en: For a signal.
sentences.zh: 一个信号。

sentences.en: And then he'd just say, fire.
sentences.zh: 然后他就会说，开火。

sentences.en: At first, you know, you have to, you have to bring yourself to do it.
sentences.zh: 起初，你知道的，你必须，你必须说服自己去做。

sentences.en: You're like, okay, if I'm finally killing someone now, this is maybe the next step to being a frontline fighter.
sentences.zh: 你会想，好吧，如果我现在终于要杀人了，这也许是成为前线战士的下一步。

sentences.en: And I already had some goals for being a frontline fighter.
sentences.zh: 我本来就为成为前线战士定下了一些目标。

sentences.en: I'm like, okay, so this is, I guess, the next stepping stone for me.
sentences.zh: 我想，好吧，所以我想这就是我的下一个踏脚石。

sentences.en: And the interesting thing is that Josefa has this moment where he's standing behind the man that he's about to execute.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，胡泽法有这样一个时刻：他站在他即将处决的人身后。

sentences.en: And for a second, it looks like the social pressure might actually not work.
sentences.zh: 有一秒钟，看起来社交压力可能根本不起作用。

sentences.en: You start slow.
sentences.zh: 你慢慢来。

sentences.en: You're like, okay, just slowly you can do this.
sentences.zh: 你会想，好吧，慢慢来，你能做到的。

sentences.en: This, don't worry.
sentences.zh: 这个，别担心。

sentences.en: He's a muerte.
sentences.zh: 他是个叛教者。

sentences.en: You're killing him for a reason.
sentences.zh: 你杀他是有理由的。

sentences.en: This is justified.
sentences.zh: 这是正义的。

sentences.en: You can do this.
sentences.zh: 你能做到的。

sentences.en: You're not going to be held accountable.
sentences.zh: 你不会被追究责任的。

sentences.en: In Josefa's telling, he can't pull the trigger.
sentences.zh: 在胡泽法的叙述中，他无法扣动扳机。

sentences.en: You bring yourself to do it.
sentences.zh: 你努力说服自己去做。

sentences.en: You're like, okay, now, now.
sentences.zh: 你会想，好吧，就是现在，就是现在。

sentences.en: But you can't bring the pressure.
sentences.zh: 但你承受不住这种心理压力。

sentences.en: And it's at this moment when he looks down.
sentences.zh: 就在这个时候，他往下看了一眼。

sentences.en: They look like regular good MusliMs.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来就像普通的好穆斯林。

sentences.en: They had their beards.
sentences.zh: 他们留着胡子。

sentences.en: And realizes he's, he's just a guy.
sentences.zh: 然后他意识到，他，他只是个人。

sentences.en: They were old and they were tribal guys.
sentences.zh: 他们年纪大了，而且是部落成员。

sentences.en: Slowly you can do this.
sentences.zh: 慢慢来，你能做到的。

sentences.en: You're killing him for a reason.
sentences.zh: 你杀他是有理由的。

sentences.en: This is justified.
sentences.zh: 这是正义的。

sentences.en: You can do this.
sentences.zh: 你能做到的。

sentences.en: You're not going to be held accountable.
sentences.zh: 你不会被追究责任的。

sentences.en: They put themselves in that situation.
sentences.zh: 他们把自己置于那种境地。

sentences.en: They killed themselves.
sentences.zh: 是他们自寻死路。

sentences.en: You kind of just have to close your eyes and do it.
sentences.zh: 你基本上只能闭上眼睛开枪。

sentences.en: And just shoot.
sentences.zh: 直接开枪。

sentences.en: After you pulled that trigger, does he just fall?
sentences.zh: 在你扣动扳机后，他是直接倒下吗？

sentences.en: You feel the pressure from the gun and everything.
sentences.zh: 你甚至能感觉到枪传来的压力和一切。

sentences.en: And you've, I guess you feel bits coming back at you when, from his head, I guess.
sentences.zh: 而且我猜，当血浆从他的头部溅出来时，我猜你会觉得有一些碎片回落到你身上。

sentences.en: Then they fall forward.
sentences.zh: 然后他们向前倒去。

sentences.en: And when it calms down so you can see where the damage is and everything.
sentences.zh: 等尘埃落定，你能看清破坏程度和一切的时候。

sentences.en: Did you knock?
sentences.zh: 你敲门了吗？

sentences.en: I peeked, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我偷看了一下，对。

sentences.en: But I just kept looking down at his feet.
sentences.zh: 但我一直盯着他的脚看。

sentences.en: I didn't want to look at his head.
sentences.zh: 我不想看他的头。

sentences.en: And then I, uh, I kept thinking we killed them.
sentences.zh: 然后我，呃，我一直觉得是我们杀了他们。

sentences.en: Like they were middle-aged men.
sentences.zh: 就像他们是中年男子一样。

sentences.en: And I'm just a kid.
sentences.zh: 而我只是个孩子。

sentences.en: Did you pick up the bodies or did somebody else do that?
sentences.zh: 是你把尸体抬走的，还是别人干的？

sentences.en: No, that was, that someone else came and did that.
sentences.zh: 不，那是，那是别人来干的。

sentences.en: And there was a truck, a large truck.
sentences.zh: 还有一辆卡车，一辆大卡车。

sentences.en: We just gathered them and took them away.
sentences.zh: 我们只是把他们收殓起来，然后运走了。

sentences.en: But we had to load them up.
sentences.zh: 但我们得把他们装上车。

sentences.en: And, you know, get them piled from that line into like, I guess, a pile.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，把他们从那条线堆成，我猜，一个堆。

sentences.en: And then you just put them in a pile and you turned around and went back to your place?
sentences.zh: 然后你把他们堆成一堆，转身就回到你原来的地方去了？

sentences.en: Uh, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 呃，对，对。

sentences.en: Yeah, we were told to take a break for a bit.
sentences.zh: 对，我们被告知休息一会儿。

sentences.en: We'd go back, take the day off.
sentences.zh: 我们会回去，放假一天。

sentences.en: I threw up a lot that day.
sentences.zh: 那天我吐了很多次。

sentences.en: I couldn't get the smell of that stale, iron-y, bloody smell off of my hand.
sentences.zh: 我手上那股陈旧的、铁锈味的、血腥味怎么也洗不掉。

sentences.en: And like, I kept smelling it.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉，我一直能闻到那股味道。

sentences.en: But was there any emotional training as a part of this?
sentences.zh: 但作为这其中的一部分，有没有过任何心理培训？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 有。

sentences.en: They said that, they, they, I said that it's, you know, it's going to be hard for you guys.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他们，他们，我说这，你知道的，对你们来说会很艰难。

sentences.en: They said first time it's going to affect you a lot.
sentences.zh: 他们说第一次会对你影响很大。

sentences.en: You're going to be sad.
sentences.zh: 你会感到难过。

sentences.en: You're going to be sick.
sentences.zh: 你会感到恶心。

sentences.en: And you might even faint from the blood.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可能会看到血而晕倒。

sentences.en: But, um, what you have to do is you just have to drink down those emotions.
sentences.zh: 但是，嗯，你必须做的是，你必须把这些情绪咽下去。

sentences.en: Remember, you're doing this for God.
sentences.zh: 记住，你们是在为真主做这件事。

sentences.en: Remember, you're carrying out what it says in the Quran and what you have to, what your duty is as a Muslim.
sentences.zh: 记住，你在执行《古兰经》上所说的话，以及你必须履行的职责，你作为一名穆斯林的责任。

sentences.en: And, and you, I mean, you didn't question that?
sentences.zh: 而且，而且你，我是说，你难道没有质疑过吗？

sentences.en: I didn't, no.
sentences.zh: 我没有，没有。

sentences.en: I didn't question that.
sentences.zh: 我没有质疑过。

sentences.en: After that, I called in a few days sick.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我请了几天病假。

sentences.en: Like, I just told her I'm sick.
sentences.zh: 就像，我只是告诉她我生病了。

sentences.en: I can't go out.
sentences.zh: 我不能出门。

sentences.en: I'm sick and this and that.
sentences.zh: 我生病了，诸如此类的。

sentences.en: So the way Husefa tells it is that he's in his dorm and he's been given this R&R time.
sentences.zh: 所以根据侯赛法的叙述，他当时在宿舍里，并得到了这段休整时间。

sentences.en: You know, when I, when, while I did that, while I was at home, this is when they started coming in.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当我，当我这样做的时候，当我还在家的时候，正是他们开始涌入的时候。

sentences.en: Then a commander comes to see him.
sentences.zh: 然后一个指挥官来看望他。

sentences.en: And he was a Libyan guy.
sentences.zh: 他是个利比亚人。

sentences.en: He was a pretty big commander.
sentences.zh: 他是个相当大的指挥官。

sentences.en: And he's like, so you, he asked me what you want to do.
sentences.zh: 他说，所以你，他问我你想做什么。

sentences.en: He says, you can't be policed for a long time.
sentences.zh: 他说，你不可能一直当警察。

sentences.en: Come on, you're a Muhajir.
sentences.zh: 拜托，你是个穆哈吉尔（迁士）。

sentences.en: You immigrated to these lands.
sentences.zh: 你移居到了这片土地上。

sentences.en: Like, I know I wanted to be a frontline fighter.
sentences.zh: 就像，我知道我想成为一名一线战士。

sentences.en: And I heard of Rayat al-Tawheed.
sentences.zh: 我听说过“认主之旗”（Rayat al-Tawheed）。

sentences.en: That's a British battalion.
sentences.zh: 那是一个英国营。

sentences.en: What's it called?
sentences.zh: 它叫什么？

sentences.en: A British battalion, Rayat al-Tawheed.
sentences.zh: 一个英国营，“认主之旗”。

sentences.en: Rayat al-Tawheed, okay.
sentences.zh: “认主之旗”，好吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, but he's like, how would you instead recruit people?
sentences.zh: 是的，但他却说，你不如去招募人员怎么样？

sentences.en: Your family, friends come in here, live under the Khilafah.
sentences.zh: 你的家人、朋友来到这里，生活在哈里发国之下。

sentences.en: Why don't you start recruiting?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不开始招募呢？

sentences.en: We need North Americans.
sentences.zh: 我们需要北美人员。

sentences.en: And we need them to come in and fight for us.
sentences.zh: 我们需要他们来这里为我们战斗。

sentences.en: But we also need them to go back.
sentences.zh: 但我们也需要他们回去。

sentences.en: Like, don't, there's a seminar coming up.
sentences.zh: 就像，不要，有一个研讨会即将举行。

sentences.en: Come attend that.
sentences.zh: 来参加那个吧。

sentences.en: And do you, do you remember roughly when this happens?
sentences.zh: 你，你还记得这大约是什么时候发生的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, this was in July.
sentences.zh: 是的，是在七月。

sentences.en: So, according to him, around a month after the execution.
sentences.zh: 所以，据他所说，大约在行刑后一个月。

sentences.en: Frontline fighters came in and took up our positions.
sentences.zh: 一线战士进来接管了我们的阵地。

sentences.en: Fighters come and take over the position that he had held.
sentences.zh: 战士们前来接管他一直把守的阵地。

sentences.en: Checkpoints and this and that.
sentences.zh: 检查站之类的。

sentences.en: And he and the other members of the Khizba, the religious police, are trucked to a place outside of Aleppo.
sentences.zh: 他和宗教警察（Hisba）的其他成员被用卡车运到阿勒颇郊外的一个地方。

sentences.en: 70 or 75 trucks.
sentences.zh: 70或75辆卡车。

sentences.en: And they go inside of a building.
sentences.zh: 他们进入了一栋建筑内。

sentences.en: In, I think it was a government building.
sentences.zh: 在，我想那是一栋政府大楼。

sentences.en: And it is there that he suddenly looks around and sees people from all over the world.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里，他突然环顾四周，看到了来自世界各地的人。

sentences.en: And there was a lot.
sentences.zh: 人非常多。

sentences.en: There was Australians there.
sentences.zh: 那里有澳大利亚人。

sentences.en: There was British nationalists, Belgians, French.
sentences.zh: 有英国民族主义者、比利时人、法国人。

sentences.en: From Asia, from North America, from Europe.
sentences.zh: 来自亚洲、北美、欧洲。

sentences.en: There was also Central Asian, a couple of Americans, two or three other Canadians.
sentences.zh: 还有中亚人、几个美国人、另外两三个加拿大人。

sentences.en: Sitting on the floor or what was it?
sentences.zh: 坐在地板上还是怎么的？

sentences.en: Yeah, we were sitting on the floor.
sentences.zh: 对，我们坐在地板上。

sentences.en: And up there, they had, like, just on the wall, projection of Google Maps and, you know, the battlefield map and everything.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他们把，就像，直接在墙上投影出谷歌地图，你知道的，还有战场地图和一切。

sentences.en: They put Google Maps to show what?
sentences.zh: 他们放谷歌地图是为了展示什么？

sentences.en: To show how possible attacks could be carried out.
sentences.zh: 为了展示如何实施可能的袭击。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》（The Reframers），这是一个专注于设计之爱及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you
sentences.zh: 甚至在我还在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当DJ的时候，你每天都要带300件你最珍爱的藏品去上班

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个，就像，充满50年历史精美古董的微型快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼（Audemars Piguet）的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯DealBook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将采访商业、政治和文化领域一些最具影响力的领袖，包括J·D·

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德，

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人，地点在纽约市DealBook峰会的现场舞台上。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于NYTimes.com上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，你可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收听。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: So what is this meeting that he's attending?
sentences.zh: 那么他参加的这个会议是什么？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: He says it's a meeting of the Amniyat.
sentences.zh: 他说这是一场安全局（Amniyat）的会议。

sentences.en: So we all went to the seminar and this was held by the Amniyat, Amniyat al-Kharji.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都去参加了这个研讨会，这是由安全局，即外事安全局（Amniyat al-Kharji）举办的。

sentences.en: Which is essentially the secret service of ISIS.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是ISIS的秘密情报部门。

sentences.en: But he doesn't just say the Amniyat.
sentences.zh: 但他说的不仅仅是安全局。

sentences.en: He says Amniyat al-Kharji.
sentences.zh: 他说的是外事安全局。

sentences.en: Amniyat al-Kharji, which is their external operations.
sentences.zh: 外事安全局，也就是他们的海外行动部门。

sentences.en: The Amniyat al-Kharji is essentially the body inside the secret service of ISIS that is dedicated to carrying out attacks overseas.
sentences.zh: 外事安全局基本上就是ISIS秘密情报机构内部专门负责在海外实施袭击的机构。

sentences.en: This is the group that we believe was behind the Paris attack, the Brussels attack, the Bardot Museum attack in Tunisia, maybe even the Bangladeshi attack.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，这就是制造巴黎袭击、布鲁塞尔袭击、突尼斯巴尔杜博物馆袭击，甚至可能是孟加拉国袭击的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: And when you say that, like, they carried out the Paris attacks, like, what does that look like?
sentences.zh: 当你这么说时，就像，他们实施了巴黎袭击，那是什么样子的？

sentences.en: So, the Paris attack...
sentences.zh: 所以，巴黎袭击……

sentences.en: November 13th, 10 ISIS operatives attacked Paris.
sentences.zh: 11月13日，10名ISIS特工袭击了巴黎。

sentences.en: ...was led by 10 attackers.
sentences.zh: ……由10名袭击者主导。

sentences.en: Right now we're learning more about the suspects behind the deadly Paris attack that left 129 innocent people dead.
sentences.zh: 目前，我们正在了解更多关于这起造成129名无辜平民丧生的致命巴黎袭击事件背后嫌疑人的信息。

sentences.en: One was a French extremist known to the authorities.
sentences.zh: 其中一人是当局熟知的法国极端分子。

sentences.en: They were mostly foreign fighters, Belgian and French nationals.
sentences.zh: 他们大多是外国战斗人员，具有比利时和法国国籍。

sentences.en: The documents show their journey began in Raqqa, Syria.
sentences.zh: 文件显示他们的行程始于叙利亚拉卡。

sentences.en: Who traveled to Syria, went through all of the steps that Huseifa has elucidated for us, the training camps, graduating to actually carrying out real executions,
sentences.zh: 他们前往叙利亚，经历了侯赛法为我们阐述的所有步骤，训练营，毕业到真正执行真正的处决，

sentences.en: and then were sent on a mission to attack Europe.
sentences.zh: 然后被派往欧洲执行袭击任务。

sentences.en: Greece says this man arrived on its shores claiming to be a refugee...
sentences.zh: 希腊称此人抵达其海岸时自称是难民……

sentences.en: Coming back through Turkey to Greece, Greece and to Eastern Europe.
sentences.zh: 通过土耳其返回希腊，希腊和东欧。

sentences.en: They traveled the same refugee route as thousands of people from war-torn countries.
sentences.zh: 他们走的是与饱受战争蹂躏国家的成千上万的人相同的难民路线。

sentences.en: They then went to Belgium and they spent several months in safe houses there where they collected the equipment that they needed.
sentences.zh: 然后他们前往比利时，并在那里的安全屋里度过了几个月，收集他们所需的装备。

sentences.en: The explosives used in the Paris attacks require an experienced bomb maker.
sentences.zh: 巴黎袭击中使用的炸药需要经验丰富的炸弹制造者。

sentences.en: They built the bombs that they were going to use in their suicide belts.
sentences.zh: 他们制造了准备用在自杀式炸弹背心上的炸弹。

sentences.en: They collected the automatic weapons that they were going to use.
sentences.zh: 他们收集了将要使用的自动武器。

sentences.en: And then, November 13th, 2015, they set out in three units.
sentences.zh: 然后，2015年11月13日，他们分三组出发。

sentences.en: One hit the Stade de France.
sentences.zh: 一组袭击了法兰西体育场。

sentences.en: Another one...
sentences.zh: 另一组……

sentences.en: Around the same time, in central Paris, gunmen began opening fire on diners, in cafes and restaurants.
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，在巴黎市中心，枪手开始向咖啡馆和餐馆里的用餐者开枪。

sentences.en: Shooting as many people as they could before blowing themselves off.
sentences.zh: 在引爆自己之前，尽可能多地射杀人们。

sentences.en: And the final group...
sentences.zh: 最后一组……

sentences.en: The worst of the carnage happened at the Bataclan Theater.
sentences.zh: 最惨烈的大屠杀发生在巴塔克兰剧院。

sentences.en: ...went inside the Bataclan concert hall and carried out the carnage there.
sentences.zh: ……进入巴塔克兰音乐厅并在那里实施了大屠杀。

sentences.en: And you're saying that each step, transportation, safe housing...
sentences.zh: 你是说每一个步骤，交通、安全屋……

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Communication to transportation, to the location of safe houses, to the tactics that they were going to use,
sentences.zh: 从通信到交通，到安全屋的位置，到他们将要使用的战术，

sentences.en: to the formations they were going to go in, to the assignments they had that night.
sentences.zh: 到他们将要采取的阵型，到他们当晚的任务。

sentences.en: We believe that it was this unit inside ISIS that organized all of that.
sentences.zh: 我们认为正是ISIS内部的这个部门组织了这一切。

sentences.en: They said they had a lot of people coming in.
sentences.zh: 他们说有很多人涌入。

sentences.en: Europe was a piece of cake to send people back.
sentences.zh: 把人送回欧洲简直易如反掌。

sentences.en: And he's there with them.
sentences.zh: 而他正和他们在一起。

sentences.en: French embassy was giving away passports to these guys, like, water.
sentences.zh: 法国大使馆向这些人发放护照，就像发水一样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's what...
sentences.zh: 这就是……

sentences.en: They said that it's easy.
sentences.zh: 他们说这很容易。

sentences.en: And at this point, they tell them that they're all set.
sentences.zh: 此时，他们告诉他们一切都准备好了。

sentences.en: For France, Europe in general, they're doing well.
sentences.zh: 对于法国，整个欧洲，他们进展顺利。

sentences.en: The work is just getting you to North America.
sentences.zh: 这项工作只是把你带到北美。

sentences.en: That's where we need people going back.
sentences.zh: 那是我们需要人员返回的地方。

sentences.en: We need North Americans going back.
sentences.zh: 我们需要北美人员回去。

sentences.en: And then at that point, the presenter turns to the North Americans in the room.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，演讲者转向了房间里的北美人们。

sentences.en: And they say...
sentences.zh: 他们说……

sentences.en: They had an envisionment for something as spectacular as 9-11.
sentences.zh: 他们对像9·11这样壮观的事件有着一番宏伟的构想。

sentences.en: They want to outdo al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 他们想超越基地组织。

sentences.en: Make their mark.
sentences.zh: 留下他们的印记。

sentences.en: That they have something specific and spectacular that they want to do in this region.
sentences.zh: 他们在这个地区有一些具体而壮观的事情想要去做。

sentences.en: They were just telling us examples, showing us examples of how these things would be carried out.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在告诉我们例子，向我们展示这些事情将如何被执行的例子。

sentences.en: When it comes to the details of the attack, he didn't have them.
sentences.zh: 当谈到袭击的细节时，他并没有。

sentences.en: And that's because he said this was an informational meeting where the purpose was to teach them how such an attack could be carried out.
sentences.zh: 这是因为他说这是一次通报会，其目的是教导他们如何执行这样的袭击。

sentences.en: And to do that, they started to show them pictures of monuments.
sentences.zh: 为了做到这一点，他们开始向他们展示地标的图片。

sentences.en: They gave us ideas of where we could get into, like, restricted areas.
sentences.zh: 他们给了我们关于我们可以进入哪些地方的想法，比如限制区域。

sentences.en: There's color coding.
sentences.zh: 有颜色编码。

sentences.en: There's graphics.
sentences.zh: 有图表。

sentences.en: One green line would be going in.
sentences.zh: 一条绿线是进去的。

sentences.en: Red line would be going out.
sentences.zh: 红线将是出去的。

sentences.en: They would map out possible escape routes and routes to get there.
sentences.zh: 他们将绘制出可能的逃生路线和到达那里的路线。

sentences.en: There's descriptions of tactics.
sentences.zh: 有战术的描述。

sentences.en: And what they are for us who aren't familiar with it.
sentences.zh: 对于我们这些不熟悉它的人来说，它们是用来做什么的。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of talk and brainstorming about targets.
sentences.zh: 关于目标的讨论和头脑风暴很多。

sentences.en: And then they would tell us the type of attacks we can do.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会告诉我们我们可以进行的袭击类型。

sentences.en: Doing shooting attacks.
sentences.zh: 进行枪击袭击。

sentences.en: Concerts.
sentences.zh: 音乐会。

sentences.en: Schools.
sentences.zh: 学校。

sentences.en: Cyber attacks.
sentences.zh: 网络攻击。

sentences.en: And the thing that they considered to be the cream of the cream.
sentences.zh: 以及他们认为是精华中的精华的事情。

sentences.en: They preferred martyrdom.
sentences.zh: 他们更喜欢殉道。

sentences.en: Is where the person goes in, does as much killing as they can, and then is killed in a standoff with police.
sentences.zh: 就是一个人进去，大开杀戒，然后与警察对峙时被击毙。

sentences.en: Martyrdom is the highest level you can attain.
sentences.zh: 殉道是你能达到的最高境界。

sentences.en: And for them, it's the most honorable thing you can do.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，这是你能做的最光荣的事情。

sentences.en: How are you feeling hearing all this?
sentences.zh: 听到这一切，你有什么感觉？

sentences.en: Um, I didn't like, I didn't, I didn't like it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不喜欢，我没有，我不喜欢它。

sentences.en: Like, I didn't like the fact that we're going into, uh, their land and killing them.
sentences.zh: 就像，我不喜欢我们进入他们的土地并杀死他们这个事实。

sentences.en: In my mind, the Khilafat was something that's to be regional.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，哈里发国应该是区域性的。

sentences.en: Why interfere with all these other countries?
sentences.zh: 为什么要干涉所有这些其他国家？

sentences.en: I didn't like the fact that we're sacrificing fighters.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢我们牺牲战士这一事实。

sentences.en: Why don't we just keep our vision here?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不把我们的愿景留在这里？

sentences.en: Dr. Rukmini, why don't they just, um, focus on the state and build up the state the way Huseva wants?
sentences.zh: 鲁克米尼博士，他们为什么不，嗯，专注于国家并按照胡塞瓦的要求建立国家？

sentences.en: Why attack the West?
sentences.zh: 为什么要攻击西方？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So you have to, you have to understand that, that ISIS is working on several different levels.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须，你必须明白，ISIS正在几个不同的层面上运作。

sentences.en: Their first goal is, is what you just said.
sentences.zh: 他们的第一个目标是，就是你刚刚说的。

sentences.en: It's the establishment of an Islamic state.
sentences.zh: 它是建立一个伊斯兰国。

sentences.en: It's in their name.
sentences.zh: 这在他们的名字里。

sentences.en: So their goal is to create their own proto-state, their own nation, which happens to be headquartered in Iraq and Syria.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的目标是建立他们自己的准国家，他们自己的国家，恰好总部设在伊拉克和叙利亚。

sentences.en: But they don't plan to end there.
sentences.zh: 但他们并不打算就此结束。

sentences.en: The caliphate is supposed to spread to a number of major places.
sentences.zh: 哈里发国应该蔓延到许多主要地方。

sentences.en: They're supposed to take over the city of Rome.
sentences.zh: 他们应该接管罗马市。

sentences.en: They're supposed to take over Mecca and Medina in Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 他们应该接管沙特阿拉伯的麦加和麦地那。

sentences.en: They're even supposed to take over Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至应该接管耶路撒冷。

sentences.en: But there are some ISIS fighters that have gone even further where their aim seems to be global domination.
sentences.zh: 但有一些ISIS战士走得更远，他们的目标似乎是全球统治。

sentences.en: At one point, I even saw ISIS fanboys, as we call them, sympathizers, putting out a map of the world where they had the black flag of ISIS over every single country.
sentences.zh: 有一点，我甚至看到ISIS的狂热粉丝，我们这样称呼他们，同情者，发布了一张世界地图，他们在每一个国家上都有ISIS的黑旗。

sentences.en: And one of the flags was, I remember it was planted on Greenland.
sentences.zh: 其中一面旗帜是，我记得它是插在格陵兰岛上的。

sentences.en: I remember thinking, wow, that's like, that's really bold, man.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时在想，哇，这就像，这真的很的大胆，老兄。

sentences.en: If you're going to take, if you're going to take ISIS to Greenland, you know.
sentences.zh: 如果你要带走，如果你要把ISIS带到格陵兰岛，你知道的。

sentences.en: That attacking the non-believers in their territories is a collective duty.
sentences.zh: 攻击他们领土上的非信徒是一项集体义务。

sentences.en: And this desire of theirs.
sentences.zh: 还有他们这个愿望。

sentences.en: So now we're talking about attacking them in their land.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们在谈论在他们的土地上攻击他们。

sentences.en: It comes down to prophecy.
sentences.zh: 这归结为预言。

sentences.en: Rasulullah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam says, the war between the Muslims and the Romans never ceased to exiSt.
sentences.zh: 真主的使者，愿主福安之，说，穆斯林和罗马人之间的战争从未停止过存在。

sentences.en: And who are the Romans?
sentences.zh: 谁是罗马人？

sentences.en: The prophecy is that this end-of-times battle is set into motion after Roman troops set foot in a little place in Syria called Dabik.
sentences.zh: 预言是，这场末日之战是在罗马军队踏入叙利亚一个叫做达比克的小地方后开始的。

sentences.en: When I say the Romans, I'm translating Ar-Rom.
sentences.zh: 当我说是罗马人时，我翻译的是Ar-Rom。

sentences.en: Now, Aulaqi and their ideological leaders.
sentences.zh: 现在，奥拉基和他们的思想领袖。

sentences.en: Ar-Rom in the Arabic sense means European people.
sentences.zh: 阿拉伯语意义上的Ar-Rom是指欧洲人。

sentences.en: They explain that Rome, back then, back when the scripture was written, it actually meant Westerner.
sentences.zh: 他们解释说，罗马，在当时，在经文写成的时候，实际上意味着西方人。

sentences.en: So it's not limited to a political entity or a geographical entity.
sentences.zh: 所以它不限于政治实体或地理实体。

sentences.en: Therefore, Europe and its extensions would fall under Ar-Rom.
sentences.zh: 因此，欧洲及其延伸将属于Ar-Rom。

sentences.en: The U.S., Canada, Australia, New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 美国、加拿大、澳大利亚、新西兰。

sentences.en: They are going to be your opponent and your enemy as long as you're living on the face of the air.
sentences.zh: 只要你活在世上，他们就会是你的对手和敌人。

sentences.en: So they're looking for this clash with Western civilization.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在寻找与西方文明的这种冲突。

sentences.en: Jihad is a mandatory call.
sentences.zh: 圣战是一次强制性的呼吁。

sentences.en: And they're looking for ways to incite it.
sentences.zh: 他们正在寻找煽动它的方法。

sentences.en: Till none remains in the world but a Muslim.
sentences.zh: 直到世界上只剩下穆斯林。

sentences.en: Or one who has submitted to MusliMs.
sentences.zh: 或者是一个服从了穆斯林的人。

sentences.en: And we're gone for?
sentences.zh: 我们走了多久？

sentences.en: Like three hours around.
sentences.zh: 大约三个小时左右。

sentences.en: Three hours and then they bust you back?
sentences.zh: 三个小时然后他们把你送回去？

sentences.en: No, three hours and we just slept.
sentences.zh: 不，三个小时，我们只是睡觉。

sentences.en: And we had rooms, houses given to us and groups of 20s.
sentences.zh: 我们有房间，给我们的房子，每组20人。

sentences.en: We'd stay the night there and then we'd be back in Manbij.
sentences.zh: 我们会在那里过夜，然后我们会回到曼比季。

sentences.en: And most of the guys that were there were kind of like me.
sentences.zh: 那里的绝大多数人都有点像我。

sentences.en: They hadn't been on the front.
sentences.zh: 他们没有去过前线。

sentences.en: Had not been.
sentences.zh: 没有去过。

sentences.en: Had not been on the front.
sentences.zh: 没有去过前线。

sentences.en: So when you went back after the three hour presentation and you go back to sleep?
sentences.zh: 所以你在三个小时的演讲后回去，然后你回去睡觉？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What was the conversation like?
sentences.zh: 当时的对话是什么样子的？

sentences.en: It was like, I guess, regular guy stuff.
sentences.zh: 就像，我猜，普通家伙的东西。

sentences.en: We'd just talk about, like, except that would be the over shadow of the conversation would be what we just heard.
sentences.zh: 我们只会谈论，比如，除了对话的阴影将是我们刚刚听到的话。

sentences.en: So he tells us that he leaves this meeting and in his telling of it, he's feeling uncomfortable with what has happened.
sentences.zh: 所以他告诉我们，他离开了这次会议，在他的讲述中，他对发生的事情感到不舒服。

sentences.en: I was against it, but I just kept quiet as a listener type of thing.
sentences.zh: 我是反对的，但我只是作为听众类型保持沉默。

sentences.en: But in the next beat, he then describes how he and his buds go back to their dorm.
sentences.zh: 但在接下来的转折中，他随后描述了他和他的朋友们如何回到他们的宿舍。

sentences.en: Me and some guys, we'd just be talking about these big landmarks in the world and, okay, how cool would it be?
sentences.zh: 我和一些家伙，我们只会谈论世界上这些巨大的地标，好吧，那会有多酷？

sentences.en: You're talking about major landmarks to blow up?
sentences.zh: 你在谈论要炸毁的主要地标？

sentences.en: Yeah, to attack, to blow up.
sentences.zh: 是的，去攻击，去炸毁。

sentences.en: And they just start fantasizing about...
sentences.zh: 他们只是开始幻想……

sentences.en: I talked about, like, NSA and I talk about the White House.
sentences.zh: 我谈到了，像NSA，我谈到了白宫。

sentences.en: Blowing up the White House, carrying out the next 9-11, attacking a senator's office.
sentences.zh: 炸毁白宫，执行下一个9-11，袭击参议员办公室。

sentences.en: Even the monument.
sentences.zh: 甚至纪念碑。

sentences.en: I'd even talk about, like, candidates, cabinet members or senators type of thing.
sentences.zh: 我甚至会谈论，像候选人、内阁成员或参议员之类的事情。

sentences.en: And we were just, like, daydreaming, kind of.
sentences.zh: 我们只是，有点像在做白日梦。

sentences.en: And they're talking about it in this kind of giddy, fantasy kind of way.
sentences.zh: 他们以这种轻率的、幻想的方式谈论它。

sentences.en: Scenes of carnage at six different locations across Paris.
sentences.zh: 巴黎六个不同地点的血腥屠杀场景。

sentences.en: But remember, it is this very group that has shown us time and again that they can turn these fantasies into reality.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，正是这个组织一次又一次地向我们表明，他们可以将这些幻想变成现实。

sentences.en: Deadly explosions at a packed sports stadium, machine guns, and a rock concert.
sentences.zh: 拥挤的体育场发生致命爆炸、机枪和摇滚音乐会。

sentences.en: He appears to have followed almost exactly to a T the instructions that ISIS has put out.
sentences.zh: 他似乎几乎一字不差地遵循了ISIS发布的指示。

sentences.en: Police say as many as 40 hostages are still being held inside a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 警方称有多达40名人质被扣押在一家餐馆内。

sentences.en: The ISIS-affiliated news agency is reporting that these gunmen are Islamic State commandos.
sentences.zh: 与ISIS有关联的新闻机构报道说，这些枪手是伊斯兰国突击队员。

sentences.en: ISIS set up an intricate logistical support system for these terrorist cells throughout Europe.
sentences.zh: ISIS为欧洲的这些恐怖细胞建立了一个复杂的后勤支持系统。

sentences.en: Today, officials disclosed he had been planning an attack for him.
sentences.zh: 今天，官员们透露他一直在为他策划袭击。

sentences.en: Next couple months, you'll be hearing Caliphate unfold on the daily every Saturday, with Chapter 5 coming next Saturday, May 19th.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几个月里，你每天都会听到《哈里发国》的展开，每周六，第5章将在下周六5月19日到来。

sentences.en: We're also releasing Caliphate as a standalone series.
sentences.zh: 我们还将发布《哈里发国》作为一个独立的系列。

sentences.en: And we're publishing new episodes on Thursday afternoons, two days before you'll hear them on the daily.
sentences.zh: 我们将在周四下午发布新的剧集，比你在每天听到它们早两天。

sentences.en: So if you want to listen early, you can subscribe to the series by searching for Caliphate on Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, or wherever you listen.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想早点收听，你可以通过在Apple Podcasts、Stitcher或你收听的任何地方搜索Caliphate来订阅该系列。

sentences.en: And for Time subscribers, we're making episodes available a full week early.
sentences.zh: 对于时代周刊订阅者，我们将在整整一周前提供剧集。

sentences.en: So if you're a subscriber, Chapter 5 is available right now at nytimes.com slash caliphate.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是订阅者，第5章现在可以在nytimes.com/caliphate上获得。

sentences.en: That's nytimes.com slash c-a-l-i-p-h-a-t-e.
sentences.zh: That's nytimes.com slash c-a-l-i-p-h-a-t-e.

sentences.en: If you've been looking for a reason to subscribe, now might be a good time.
sentences.zh: 如果你一直在寻找订阅的理由，现在可能是一个好时机。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在Wirecutter秀上，我们正在为假期的接待做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听关于让您的客人有宾至如归的感觉的提示。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我的意思不是他们是否晕倒去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一件非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症、食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序上或在您喜欢收听的任何地方查找Wirecutter秀。
